Apple Arcade subscribers can now play Family Feud Pocket, with four additional games set to join the service later this week. Here are the details.

Family Feud Pocket now available on Apple Arcade

Earlier today, Apple Arcade added Family Feud Pocket to its growing catalog, bringing an official version of the classic TV game show to the iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Vision Pro, Apple TV, and even the iPod touch.

The game is hosted by a virtual avatar of Steve Harvey, with voice snippets such as “survey says,” and his famous funny comments permeating the rounds.

When setting up the app, players choose their first and family names, then compete to identify the answers most commonly given by survey respondents.

The gameplay also includes clues and the usual gamification elements, such as daily gameplays, quests, three different game modes (including multiplayer), and points that can be used to acquire different outfits.

Family Feud Pocket is available now on Apple Arcade, landing just a couple of days ahead of four new titles expected for July 2:

Apple Arcade is available as a standalone service for $6.99/month or included in the Apple One bundle. It includes access to over 270 games with no ads or in-app purchases.
